caveats: Three sequential warm samples per stage after ANALYZE; not p95/cold/Windows/HDD/full IPC.
Invalidation is a real write to an unrelated probe table before timing; actor business rows unchanged. This compares miss/hit paths in the same implementation, not an old-build benchmark.
Output equality checks all summary fields. Consistent fixture requires no repairs; repair-heavy workloads still rescan until a no-write pass.
Group/status aggregation still scans the conflict relation on every call; only redundant consistency maintenance is skipped. No DTO or JSON result cache.
